Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

Briefly:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit from a phone or computer on the same network installs the root certificate; then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (write and call me there), plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

(One thing: my name is set (sarah-agent) but my gender isn't — tell me if you want it set; until then I'll use neuter forms for myself.)
